title: Residue-field invertibility for the localized adic coefficient prime
statement: Fix a prime $\ell$, a finite-field datum $D$ [def-weil-finite-field-fiber] with $\ell\ne D.p$, a scheme $W$, a morphism $t:W\to\operatorname{Spec}D.k$ and $x\in W$. Define the canonical invertibility witness for $\ell$ in $W.residueField(x)$ by mapping the coefficient-prime unit along the composite of the inverse Spec global-sections isomorphism, the structure map on global sections, and residue evaluation. It is the actual `sfQbarLocalizationResidueInvertible` construction, with no extra geometric assumption.

source.place: common-stage localization coefficient construction; canonical residue-field unit for l ≠ p

def sfQbarLocalizationResidueInvertible
    (D : FiniteFieldDatum.{u}) (hl : l ≠ D.p)
    (W : Scheme.{u}) (t : W ⟶ Spec (.of D.k)) (x : W) :
    Invertible (l : W.residueField x)
